title: Ageing in the exact correlations of the voter model on a fractal
abstract: The exact behaviour of the enveloppes of the single-time and two-time correlators is found for the voter model on a fractal substrate, with nearest-neighbour interactions. Herein the geometry of the fractal substrate is described by its non-integer geometric fractal dimension $d_f$, and its topology and diffusive transport by the distinct spectral dimension $d_s$. On the level of the equations of motion of the correlators this can be modelled by considering a space-dependent diffusion constant ${\cal D}(r)\sim r^{-θ}$ which implies the spectral index $θ$, itself a function of $d_f$ and $d_s$. With a scaling ansatz, the generic phenomenology of ageing is confirmed and the dynamic exponent ${z}=2+θ$ and the autocorrelation exponent $λ=d_f$ are derived. The explicitly found dynamic scaling functions are shown to depend only on the spectral dimension $d_s$. The decay of the enveloppe of the density of active interfaces with time is described by the exponent $α=1-d_s/2$ for $d_s<2$, confirming the results of preexisting numerical simulations.
summary: This theoretical paper derives the exact scaling behavior of correlation functions for the voter model on fractal substrates. By utilizing fractal dimensions ($d_f, d_s$), the authors confirm ageing phenomenology and calculate key dynamic exponents. This work provides quantitative insights into how geometry dictates non-equilibrium dynamics in complex systems.
main_problem: The paper investigates the physical aging behavior and exact correlations of the voter model when the underlying spatial substrate is a fractal.
main_result: The authors confirm generic ageing phenomenology and derive specific exponents ($\lambda = d_f$, $z = 2 + 	heta$) that depend on the fractal's geometric ($d_f$) and spectral ($d_s$) dimensions.
method: The analysis employs continuum limits, scaling ansatzes, and models the dynamics using a space-dependent diffusion constant to derive the envelopes of correlators.
model_or_system: The system is the voter model, treated as a classical spin model on a lattice, whose dynamics are analyzed on a fractal substrate characterized by $d_f$ and $d_s$.
key_observables: Single-time and two-time auto-correlators, the density of active interfaces ($n_r(t)$), and the dynamic exponent ($z$).
important_parameters: Geometric fractal dimension ($d_f$), spectral dimension ($d_s$), and the spectral index ($	heta$).
main_assumptions: The analysis focuses on the smooth envelopes of the correlators, neglecting complex log-periodic behavior inherent to deterministic fractals.
paper_structure: The paper proceeds by establishing the continuum limit for correlators, deriving effective diffusion equations, and applying scaling arguments to determine the exponents governing the decay of observables.
why_interesting: The study of non-equilibrium dynamics, aging, and critical phenomena on fractal structures provides a rich theoretical playground relevant to understanding complex many-body systems far from equilibrium.
